RSS Chief Mohan Bhagwat to Address Over 2,000 Students in Mumbai

RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat is scheduled to interact with more than 2,000 high school students, aged 15 to 19, from over 100 cities across India. The event will take place on August 6 at the Ambani Centre in Mumbai. This outreach program targets Gen Z and Gen Alpha students. Separately, Dipankar Bhattacharya of the CPI(ML) and Abhijeet Dipke of CJP have questioned the RSS's planned interaction with young people.
